title: Document, place and release (minor)
goal: Projects can adopt the builder from a tagged release
acceptance: Placement decided and recorded: the solution stack's copy list (as B-129 placed `solution.mjs`) or every project; `solution/package-scripts.json` or `core/package-scripts.json` names an `index:build` script accordingly
Documentation of the CLI and schema in the solution profile page; CHANGELOG entry; `VERSION` and `.harness.json` at the next minor; `core/tools/` copied to `tools/`
Tag and Release published as "Releasing" says; the coordinator is told in the record that coordinator:F-024-T02 can start
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Fixtures are invented; a token is read from the environment, never written.
validation: npm run check:fast; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption
